Air India Appoints New CEO Amidst Pending Security Clearance

Tewolde Gebremariam has taken charge as the new CEO of Air India, succeeding Campbell Wilson. The appointment comes as the airline faces significant challenges, including issues with safety, operational reliability, and record losses. However, Gebremariam's security clearance is reportedly still pending.
